title: Whether Minibar Charges Count as Spend the Property Credit May Meet, Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Whether the minibar charges standing on a Hotel Rate Plans folio count as charges the property credit may be spent against turns on whether such charges are there at all and on whether the rate plan booked includes all meals.

## The rule

1. Where the folio carries minibar charges and the rate plan booked includes all meals, 0 percent of the minibar charges posted is counted as a charge the credit may be spent against.
2. Where the folio carries minibar charges and the rate plan booked does not include all meals, 100 percent of them is counted.
3. Where the folio carries no minibar charge, 0 percent is counted.

## Which plans include all meals

| Rate plan | Meals, soft drinks and listed activities all included | Share of minibar charges counted, where such charges stand |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 100 percent |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 100 percent |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 0 percent |

The All-Inclusive Flex Rate is the only plan on which the first case is reached.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Minibar charges of 85.00 USD standing on the folio:

- On the Member Flex Rate, 100 percent counts, giving 85.00 USD of charges the credit may be spent against.
- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, 0 percent counts, giving 0.00 USD.
- Where no minibar charge stood on the folio, 0 percent of nothing would be counted on either plan.
